design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (non-workflow), difficulty card_billing_payments_and_disputes.

[0] Scope snapshot. Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: card_ext_autopay_miss_late_fee_ground (card_fee_reversal, reverse_autopay_late_fee_e77f172c), card_ext_autopay_source_restoration (card_rewards_redeem deposit_to_checking, restore_overdrawn_checking_with_points_4e4b44ef), card_ext_rewards_balance_payoff (card_rewards_redeem statement credit + card_rewards_credit, apply_points_to_card_balance_295c0528); workflows []. Reserved for task 1: the single workflow (closing SOP: annual-fee refund, closing autopay, closing cash-out redemption, closure confirmation) on card_fee_reversal(annual), card_set_autopay, card_rewards_redeem(closing), card_close - four write events and three policy cores untouched here, so a >=4-step immediate workflow remains. Cross-category constraint found at Step 0: the DSL cross primitives read only other product lines, and the only card rules that name another product are the autopay source (card_evt_payments), deposit redemptions (card_evt_rewards) and the Private Client combined cap (card_agg_combined_credit_lines, not usable: other cards' limits are unreadable per holding). Every policy here therefore reads the cardholder's checking account (status, negative_since_date, ledger_balance). card_interest_reversal and card_reprice were rejected because card_evt_penalty_and_military_rates' gate active_duty_on_file applies to both and would have to hold.

[1] Why a good test / thesis. Surface goal: 'use my cash back to pay down my card balance'. Scored values: adjustment_reason=bank_error, 6418 points restoring the checking, 24442 points of statement credit. Hidden chain: the payoff rule makes two other matters prerequisites (reverse any late fee billed contrary to the charter; restore an overdrawn autopay source first). Discovering them needs the ledger (a 32.00 late fee posted 2026-09-12, no payment on 2026-09-11), the autopay fields on the card and the checking record (active, ledger -64.18, negative since 2026-09-13). Depth: payoff <- reversal (value), payoff <- restoration (gate). Breadth: points reconciled from 26 earn rows, 1 clawback forfeit, the tier's point value/minimum, the balance after reversal, and three cross-category checking reads. The customer never names the fee or the overdraft.

[2] Problem-tree card. Root card_ext_rewards_balance_payoff. Edge A: payoff -> card_ext_autopay_miss_late_fee_ground, value_input, gate=balance, condition 'Every late payment fee on the card that was billed contrary to the charter has been reversed before the rewards statement credit is sized.', policy_source 'any late payment fee on the card that was billed contrary to this charter must first be reversed, so that the balance the points pay reflects only what the cardholder owes', resolved_by reverse_autopay_late_fee_e77f172c; false at 2026-09-15 because fee row 7531336e... (late_payment, 32.00) is unreversed and current_balance is 276.42. Edge B: payoff -> card_ext_autopay_source_restoration, state_gate, gate=card_transactions.counterparty_account_id, policy_source 'when the PCB checking account named as the card's autopay source is overdrawn, the points needed to restore it must first be deposited to it under card_ext_autopay_source_restoration', resolved_by restore_overdrawn_checking_with_points_4e4b44ef; false because checking df4449dd... ledger_balance -64.18 and no deposit_to_checking row exists. Topological order: [late_fee_ground, source_restoration, payoff]. Parallel edges are independent (different rows and fields); swapped replay hash f2873122f888bc1e = gold. Deletion sensitivity (executed): skip A -> payoff 25035 (avail-bound) instead of 24442, hash 68381351027664fe; skip B -> payoff 24442 but rewards_balance 7011 not 593 and deposit row missing, hash c416da749ab35ff6. user_scenario names neither problem; tools validate nothing.

[3] Base-invariant card. card_fee_reversal (step 6) is governed only by card_evt_fee_reversal: courtesy_count (0 courtesy reversals ever < 1 allowed for Cash Rewards, evidence the fee row's customer_id/adjustment_reason/posted_date), prior_on_time (11 consecutive autopay payments on the due date or next business day before the late 2026-08 statement >= 6), account_open_for_courtesy (status active), reverse_once (no reversal references fee 7531336e...). They are inherited even though the ground is bank_error. card_evt_payments and card_evt_late_and_returned_payment_fees are cited as input lineage (autopay debits on the due date; the fee is written for the missed cycle). card_rewards_redeem (steps 8 and 10) is governed by card_evt_rewards: redeem_while_active, card status active (days_past_due 4, far below the 60-day forfeiture). No time eligibility applies to these subjects, so temporal_feasibility is []. overwrite is [] for all three: late_fee_ground refines the bank_error clause ('any fee billed contrary to this charter') with the autopay clause ('Automatic payment debits the named PCB checking account on the due date'); the two redemption policies apply base's whole-point, minimum, cash-value and half-up rules unchanged and add only sizing and ordering.

[4] Business-object card. Target objects: the single late fee row (fee_code late_payment, 2026-09-12, cycle 2026-08) - no other fee exists; the card's points ledger (earn rows keyed by source purchase, one redemption none before, one forfeit linked to merchant credit 2025-11-14 on the 4000.00 Floor & Decor purchase: 6000 x 500/4000 = 750); the autopay source checking df4449dd... (only checking account). Balance rows: 26 purchases, 1 merchant credit, 1 fee, 11 autopay payments (each the statement balance of its cycle) -> 276.42 = 154.02 (Aug statement) + 67.41 + 22.99 + 32.00.

[5] Seed rows and why. customers (identity), checking_accounts (the cross-category factor: status/negative_since/ledger), card_accounts (tier, balance, statement fields, autopay), 66 card_transactions (history for points and balance). Removing the forfeit changes unredeemed 31453->32203 (payoff unaffected since balance-bound, restoration unaffected); removing the late fee changes the ground to none; removing earn rows shrinks points below the balance. No cache trap: rewards_balance 31453 and current_balance 276.42 equal the ledger. Automatic clauses checked: no interest (every statement paid in full by due until the missed August one, whose interest would first bill on the 2026-09-17 statement, after frozen time), no penalty APR (4 dpd), no forfeiture (60 dpd), no dispute open.

[6] Persona. Ophelia, hurried librarian, surface request only; credentials 3365550166 / 1987-03-19 / 6427 (ZIP and email only if pressed); does not know balance or points; conditional reactions: agrees to 'put enough of the points into my checking to cover it' only after the agent reports the overdraft; accepts a fee correction without arguing the ground; leftover points stay on the card; autopay unchanged; closes after hearing the balance is paid down (the last gold action).

[7] Standard solution and reachability. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB, SSN4) -> find_card_accounts -> find_card_transactions -> find_checking_accounts -> KB: payoff rule reveals the two prerequisites -> late-fee rule: fees_in_window 1, reversals 0, option statement_balance covers the minimum, source status active, negative since 2026-09-13 > due 2026-09-11, no payment on 2026-09-11 -> bank_error; reverse 32.00 -> restoration rule: ceil(64.18/0.01)=6418 >= 2500, unredeemed 31453 -> hand tool, she redeems 6418/64.18 -> payoff rule: balance 244.42 -> 24442 points, unredeemed 25035, active checking caps at the balance -> hand tool, she redeems 24442/244.42. Easy mistakes: courtesy_waiver instead of bank_error; sizing the credit on 276.42 (27642 wanted, only 25035 available); forgetting the restoration; using rewards_balance before the deposit; depositing 2500 (minimum) instead of 6418.

[8] Verification code (scratch replay, executed 2026-09 authoring): for each computation, replay gold writes before its step with the real tools on DB.seeded(initial_state), evaluate the policy compute with check_compute.build_env/eval_compute, print bindings; then replay skipping a prerequisite's step and replay with swapped order. Output: late_fee_ground step 6 => bank_error {fees_in_window 1, reversals 0, covers True, status active, neg_since 2026-09-13, payments_on_due 0}; restoration step 8 => 6418 {ledger -64.18, needed 6418, earned 32203, redeemed 0, forfeited 750, unredeemed 31453}; payoff step 10 => 24442 {balance 244.42, cover 24442, unredeemed 25035, active}; SKIP A => 25035; SKIP B => 24442; ORDER swap hash = gold hash. computations.expected and the gold arguments equal these values.

[9] rule<->compute sweep. late_fee_ground: window 'less than one whole calendar month' = within_months=1 on posted_date; 'minus the late payment fee reversals' = reversals_in_window; four conditions = covers_minimum / source_status / funded_on_due_date / payments_on_due_date; 'result is none' = else branch. restoration: shortfall, ceil, ledger count (earn - redeem - forfeit), greater-of with minimum, 'all unredeemed points instead' = points_short branch, no deposit below minimum = guard. payoff: balance at handling time after reversals, ceil, ledger count, active-checking lesser-of vs all-points branch, zero/minimum guard. Every binding quotes its sentence in compute_basis; no unclaimed quantity sentence remains (the cash-value sentence is the non-computed amount argument, traced in argument_uniqueness_tracing).

[10] Draft recomputation from visible context only (KB prose of the three policies + tool docstrings + lookup returns + persona): the same three writes in the same order with the same values; the only alternative readings (courtesy ground; crediting all 25035 points) are excluded by 'courtesy allowance is neither used nor consulted' and 'the lesser of the unredeemed points and the points that cover the balance'.

[11] Gates run for task 0: check_extended OK, check_task_tools OK, replay OK (69/69 closure), check_solvability OK, check_compute OK (34 factors, 56 history rows, 21 branches), check_grounding OK, check_cross_fire OK. Revision log: check_extended first failed because helper functions in task_tools.py were counted as undiscoverable task tools -> helpers rewritten as module-level lambdas -> all green.

[12] Round 2 note: the policy-task audit passed this task; only observation O-T0-2 was touched (the two leftover-points and autopay questions in required_user_inputs are no longer labelled must-ask). No policy, seed, persona or gold value changed.

[13] Round 3 note (KB audit source-layer notes N1, N2, N3): the restoration rule no longer says the points are redeemed 'first' (the ordering lives only in the payoff's prerequisite) and states that the policy records the redemption on the card only, the checking account's own ledger entry not being posted by it; the restoration tool docstring says the same. The cash-out policy's overwrite now keeps the general deposit way outside a closing, so this task's non-closing deposit is consistent with the tier's rewards_redemption_types. No seed, persona, gold value or hash changed (replay f2873122f888bc1e).

[14] Round 4 note (KB audit source-layer findings S-1, S-2, S-3 all concern task 1's closing policies, workflow and cash-out tool): the only asset of this task touched is the restoration tool's receipt gloss, which now says receiving_account_id is the checking account the redemption entry names as receiving the deposit instead of 'the checking account credited' (R3-O-1; the tool body is unchanged). The cash-out overwrite's opening clause that keeps deposits outside a closing is unchanged, so [13] still holds. No policy, seed, persona, gold value or hash of this task changed (replay f2873122f888bc1e).
user_scenario: You are Ophelia Rasmussen, a thirty-nine-year-old middle school librarian in Greensboro, calling Piedmont Crescent Bank on a Tuesday morning during your planning period, so you are friendly but a little hurried. Last fall you and your husband redid the kitchen and the hall bathroom and put nearly all of it on your Cash Rewards Visa, the card ending in 7318, so you know you have built up a good pile of cash back, though you have never checked the exact amount. Why you are calling is simple: you want to use my cash back to pay down my card balance, right now on this call, and if it happens to cover the whole balance, even better. You are glad to approve or click through anything the agent sends you yourself; you just want it done today. You start by giving your mobile number, 3365550166, so they can find you. When the agent asks you to verify who you are, you give your date of birth as 1987-03-19 and the last four of your Social Security number, 6427; only if they still need more do you add your ZIP code, 27408, or your email, ophelia.rasmussen@gmail.com. You do not remember your balance or how many points you have, and you tell the agent they will have to look that up. If the agent tells you your checking account is overdrawn and that the points have to go there first, you are embarrassed, since you have not looked at it since the weekend, and you say something like "oh no, okay, yes, put enough of the points into my checking to cover it"; if they ask which account, it is your Everyday Checking ending 6092, the one your card's autopay comes out of. If the agent mentions that a fee on the card is being taken off or corrected, you just thank them and say you trust them on it; you do not argue about what kind of reversal it is. Whenever the agent hands you something to run or approve, you do it right away and, if they ask, read back what it shows. If the agent asks whether you want any leftover points sent somewhere, you say no, leave whatever is left on the card for now; if they ask about your autopay, you say to leave it the way it is. Once the agent tells you the points have been applied and your card balance is paid down, you thank them and say that is everything you needed today.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before any account information is discussed or points and fees are moved.

request_binding.action_semantics: The ledger holds an unreversed late payment fee billed after the bank failed to take the autopay debit on the 2026-09-11 due date; the payoff policy says such a fee must be reversed before a rewards statement credit is sized, so the obligation selects a fee reversal on the bank_error ground, not a courtesy waiver and not a dispute credit.

The payment history immediately before the late statement must show at least late_fee_courtesy_min_prior_on_time consecutive on-time payments, counted by card_msr_consecutive_on_time.
The account must be active or suspended when a courtesy reversal is granted.
A fee can be reversed at most once.

edges.condition: Every late payment fee on the card that was billed contrary to the charter has been reversed before the rewards statement credit is sized.
edges.policy_source: any late payment fee on the card that was billed contrary to this charter must first be reversed, so that the balance the points pay reflects only what the cardholder owes

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At 2026-09-15 the 32.00 late payment fee of 2026-09-12 is on the card and unreversed, although the four bank_error conditions hold (autopay statement_balance, active source, source not overdrawn until 2026-09-13, no payment on the 2026-09-11 due date); it is still inside current_balance 276.42.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The step-6 card_fee_reversal (bank_error, source_item_id = the fee) posts and current_balance becomes 244.42, so the payoff's balance binding is 244.42 and cover_points 24442.

edges.condition: An overdrawn autopay source checking account has already received its restoring deposit redemption before any points are applied to the card balance.
edges.policy_source: when the PCB checking account named as the card's autopay source is overdrawn, the points needed to restore it must first be deposited to it under card_ext_autopay_source_restoration

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Everyday Checking named as the card's autopay source is overdrawn (ledger_balance -64.18 since 2026-09-13) and no deposit_to_checking redemption naming it exists on the card.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The step-8 redemption posts a card_rewards_redeem row with redemption_type deposit_to_checking and counterparty_account_id = the autopay source, 6418 points; unredeemed points fall to 25035.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and independent: the reversal writes a new fee-reversal row and current_balance, the restoring deposit writes a new redemption row and rewards_balance; neither reads what the other writes. Replaying gold with the two swapped (actions 7,8 before 5,6) gives terminal hash f2873122f888bc1e, identical to gold, and the payoff still computes 24442.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 6 leaves current_balance 276.42: cover_points becomes 27642, which exceeds the 25035 unredeemed points, so the payoff computes 25035 instead of 24442, and the fee-reversal row is missing (terminal hash 68381351027664fe vs gold f2873122f888bc1e).

Skipping step 8 leaves the payoff at 24442 (balance-bound) but the restoring deposit row is absent and rewards_balance ends at 7011 instead of 593 (terminal hash c416da749ab35ff6 vs gold f2873122f888bc1e).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the payoff ('use my cash back to pay down my card balance'). It never names the late fee, the autopay miss or the overdraft, and never asks whether something must be settled first; the checking restoration and the fee appear only as conditional reactions after the agent says them ('If the agent tells you your checking account is overdrawn...', 'If the agent mentions that a fee on the card is being taken off...').
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: apply_points_to_card_balance_295c0528 reads only the card account row and posts the redemption and credit it is given; it never checks for an unreversed fee or an overdrawn checking account. reverse_autopay_late_fee_e77f172c and restore_overdrawn_checking_with_points_4e4b44ef likewise post whatever they receive without status or eligibility checks (see task_tools.py function bodies: find the card row, ctx.create, ctx.update, return receipt).
